name: Solid FEM
panel.honest: Ucwaningo olungu-linear static noma modal lwale ngxenye ngelayibrari yezakhi ezinhlanu ye-CadCraft (ama-tetrahedra wesibalo sesibili). Ukunyakaza okuncane, impahla ye-isotropic enokuqina okungu-linear; akukho ukuthintana, akukho ukuvuna. Usizo lokuhlaziya kunjiniyela, hhayi ukuvunywa kwedizayini.
mat.label: Impahla
mesh.info: ama-tetrahedra wesibalo sesibili: {n}, izinodi: {nodes}, okungaziwa: {dofs}, usayizi: {h} mm
kind.label: Ucwaningo
plot.too_big: Ipulotha izodinga amatriyangela angu-{n}; umkhawulo ungu-60000. Sebenzisa imeshi enkulu kancane.
plot.shown: Ipulotha ibekiwe emodelini ({n} amabhendi emibala, ukuguquka x{scale}). Okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuwukuphansi kakhulu, okubomvu kuwukuphezulu kakhulu.
plot.stale: Izilungiselelo zishintshile ngemva kokubekwa kwepulotha; ibonisa umphumela wangaphambili. Xazulula futhi ubeke ipulotha entsha.
msg.pick: Chofoza izibuso zengxenye ku-3D view ukuze uzengeze kulokhu: {id}. Chofoza futhi ukuze ususe. Cindezela Qedile ukukhetha uma usuqedile.
msg.no_faces: Lengxenye alinazibuso ezibizwe ngamagama okukhethwa kuzo (sebenzisa i-mesh kernel noma i-exact kernel).
msg.no_part: Akukho ngxenye eqinile yokwenza imeshi. Qala wakha ingxenye.
msg.too_fine: Usayizi wesakhi osencane kangaka uzokwenza cishe izakhi ezingu-{n}; umkhawulo kwikhasi ungu-{max}. Sebenzisa usayizi omkhulu, noma usebenzise imodeli enkulu kwisiteshi somsebenzi.
msg.mesh_big: Imeshi inezakhi: {n}; umkhawulo kwikhasi: {max}. Sebenzisa usayizi wesakhi omkhulu.
msg.done: Kuxazululiwe: ukunyakaza okukhulu {d} mm, ingcindezi enkulu ye-von Mises {s} MPa.
msg.stale: Ingxenye ishintshile. Yenza imeshi bese uxazulula futhi.
note.liability: Akuhlolwe kwekhodi; unjiniyela wakho ubheka imiphumela.
note.limits: Linear elastic, ukunyakaza okuncane, impahla ye-isotropic. Uxinzelelo ezisekelweni, ezindaweni zomthwalo nasemagumini abukhali kuncike kwimeshi. Izinombolo zalolu layibrari, hhayi zanoma yiluphi olunye uhlelo.
w.too_many: Izakhi: {n}; ziningi kunalokho ikhasi elingaxazulula (umkhawulo: {max}). Sebenzisa usayizi wesakhi omkhulu, noma usebenzise imodeli enkulu kwisiteshi somsebenzi.
w.bad_elements: Izakhi: {n} zinevolumu eyize noma engemihle. Yenza imeshi futhi ngosayizi wesakhi ohlukile.
w.support_no_faces: Ukusekelwa: {id} akunazibuso kwimeshi. Khetha kabusha izibuso zakho.
w.no_support: Akukho okubamba ingxenye. Engeza ubuso obuqinile.
w.under_held: Ingxenye ayibanjiwe: kusele {n} kwezinyathelo eziyisithupha zokunyakaza okuqinile ezikhululekile. Engeza ubuso obuqinile ukuze inganyakazi noma iguquke.
w.load_no_faces: Umthwalo: {id} awunazibuso kwimeshi. Khetha kabusha izibuso zakho.
w.faces_gone: {id}: ezinye zezibuso zayo azisaseyingxenyeni futhi zishiywe ngaphandle.
w.gravity_no_density: Ukudonsela phansi kudinga ubuningi; le mpahla ayinalo, ngakho ukudonsela phansi akungezi umthwalo.
w.modal_not_converged: Ukusesha kwemvamisa akuhlanganganga ngokuphelele; phatha izimodi eziphezulu ngokucophelela.
w.unbalanced: Ukusabela kokusekelwa akulingani nemithwalo (umehluko ohlobene {rel}). Ungathembeli emiphumelweni.
w.coarse: Izakhi: {n} kuphela: imeshi ebanzi. Yenza kahle (usayizi wesakhi omncane) bese uqhathanisa ngaphambi kokuthembela koxinzelelo.
w.large_disp: Ukunyakaza okukhulu kakhulu kungu-{pct}% wosayizi wengxenye. Lolu cwaningo lucabanga ukunyakaza okuncane; umphumela awuthembekile.
w.over_yield: Uxinzelelo olukhulu kakhulu ({vm} MPa) lungaphezu koxinzelelo lokuvuna ({y} MPa). Ucwaningo olungu-linear alukwazi ukulandela impahla ngemva kokuvuna; uxinzelelo olukhonjisiwe akuyona langempela.
w.stress_spread: Uxinzelelo olungalungisiwe emasakhini enodi ({raw} MPa) lukhulu kakhulu kunesilinganiso senodi ({avg} MPa): ukuphakama kubukhali noma imeshi ibanzi lapho. Yenza kahle bese uqhathanisa.
w.singular: Uxinzelelo ezisekelweni, ezindaweni zomthwalo nasemagumini abukhali lukhula njengoba imeshi yenziwa kahle; lufundeke ngokucophelela.
